items.title: Amos White Interview, 1958-08-23
items.q: we had no relationship other than a business way, but she was all business.

ctx.x: I get a dollar half a thousand from him. I said, oh, you can't work with me. You got a dollar half a thousand.

You got a dollar half a thousand. You can't get. I said, the paper costs more than that. How much you want to work for me? He said, I said, $25 a week. You make the price on the job and everything? I said, I'll price all the jobs. You give the people good work? I said, I'll give them good work. Where you learn estimating at? I said, I've had charge of the job department of the Charleston Metro ever since I was a boy. I said, I can price my job, and I can price the stock, and I'll give you a profit. I said, but if…
